notes:
Key context: Ironwood runs a distributed contact center (voice + chat) with heavy seasonal spikes (billing cycles). Primary pain: agents spend 30-40% of time searching across Confluence KB, legacy CRM notes, and attached PDFs. Looking for RAG solution that: 1) returns citations and sources; 2) prioritizes freshness for policy pages; 3) supports multi-source retrieval (Confluence, S3 attachments, internal ticket DB).

POC ask: ingest ~80k doc KB (confluence pages + 15k ticket threads + 20k attachments), provide per-answer citations, support tool-calling for CRM updates (create/update ticket, add internal note), and deliver agent-assist snippets + 1-2 sentence TL;DR summaries for triage. Must handle 10k concurrent chat/voice requests during monthly spikes with graceful degradation to smaller model variants.

Security: must use VPC peering to pull attachments, SSO (SAML) for RBAC, audit logs for every model invocation, and KMS-managed keys for dataset encryption. Data residency: EU region requirement for a subset of EU customer tickets; they asked about Private deployment option for EU-only processing.

Quote from VP Eng: "We need citations and freshness guarantees — the KB changes daily during billing windows; hallucination will kill us. Can you show real-world retrieval precision?"

POC success metrics (agreed): 20% drop in AHT, >=90% citation precision, median RAG retrieval + generation <350ms for prioritized queries, ticket summarization accuracy >85% (human eval), no privacy leaks in audit samples.

Operational asks: autoscaling for burst windows, model routing rules (latency-first for live agent assist, cost-fallback for async summarization), KV/prefix cache for repeated flows, and suggestion engine for next-best-actions (tool-calls).
